in_hebrew.name: Astto
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Astto הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'astos', meaning 'divine' or 'heavenly'. In Greek mythology, Astto was a goddess of the hearth, home, and family. In Christianity, the name Astto is a nod to the divine nature of God.
